whats_new:
## What's new
SSE presence endpoint + client subscriber.
whats_reused:
## What's reused
Existing session-auth middleware + doc-view's EventSource client.

components_detail.name: presence
components_detail.responsibility: track + fan out who-is-here per doc

wiring_matrix.exemption: internal counter — rationale: emitted to the metrics sink, never called by app code (WIRE-1 exemption variant)

assumptions_proven.statement: Safari's EventSource auto-reconnects after a network drop (the SSE retry/backoff premise).

cross_domain_transfer._note: Optional (Phase 2.1). Present only when this design imports a pattern from another domain. Tier-gated: omit on low/mechanical slices. status per invariant: holds (reasoned true here) | must-verify (empirically decidable, not yet proven -> a /critique focus + re-spike candidate) | fails (precondition does not hold here -> that part of the analogy dropped).
cross_domain_transfer.pattern: CRDT-style convergent replica: each client view is an eventually-consistent set of who-is-here
cross_domain_transfer.rationale: Presence is a converging-replica problem, not a request/response one — importing CRDT convergence avoids a brittle hand-rolled sync.

invariants.evidence: events carry a server-assigned sequence; replaying in any order converges

invariants.precondition: one SSE server can fan out to the expected concurrent viewers
invariants.evidence: spiked at R-27 — held to ~120 conns, fallback to managed pub/sub above that

invariants.precondition: client clocks are synced within the staleness tolerance
invariants.evidence: clients have no synced clock — dropped; use the server-assigned sequence instead of client timestamps

tournament._note: Optional (Phase 3). Present only when the tier-gated multi-designer tournament ran (omit on low/mechanical single-flight slices). selected: core|partial|none. decidable_disagreements (verdict pending here) are adjudicated by the post-synthesis /risk-spike --mode design (reality fills go/no-go); taste_disagreements fall through to /critique + the user. channeled_experts feeds the /critique expert-independence guard (the Critic must be a DIFFERENT expert). approach_divergence (3.3) classifies each designer-PAIR's proposals as identical|overlapping|disjoint — it MEASURES the 'diverse at generation' claim instead of asserting it; the synthesis also appends it to a design-tournament gate-log row so /pulse --full can track, over a project, whether the expert lens earns its cost (if practice~expert is identical/overlapping on most high-tier slices, drop to 2 designers).

proposals.approach: CRDT-style convergent replica over SSE — presence as an eventually-consistent set
channeled Kleppmann — CRDT presence with an explicit causal-order log

tournament.selection_rationale: SSE over managed pub/sub — CRG shows doc-view already holds an EventSource (CRG-fit); CRDT convergence is spike-able + reversible; dropped the causal-order log as YAGNI (simplest-that-works).
tournament.coherence_check: all chosen pieces assume eventual consistency + server-assigned sequence ordering — no contradictory consistency model.

decidable_disagreements.question: can one SSE server fan out to the expected concurrent viewers, or is managed pub/sub required above N?

taste_disagreements: presence set keyed by userId vs sessionId — boundary choice deferred to /critique + user
